newsitem.title: USA: U.S. June S&P 500s extend rally in late trading.
newsitem.headline: U.S. June S&P 500s extend rally in late trading.

text.p: April 14 - U.S. June S&P 500 extended its rally late, hitting a fresh daily high at 748.20 in brisk trade. Traders said Friday's selloff overdone, particularly before Tuesday's key inflation data. Traders note buystops above 741.50 and 744.00. One trader said market has 0.30 to 0.50 points of upside left into 1515 CDT/2015 GMT close, if any.
